primary_sources.scope: B7 model coverage, MSR 1FC bits 19 and 20 are R/W disable controls; HWP/legacy effect differs. No field-specific lock specified.
Separate EnergyEfficientTurbo and EnergyEfficientPState properties; RaceToHalt explicitly MSR 1FC bit 20. Structure offsets are not MSR addresses.
primary_sources.hash_note: sha256 hashes the original bytes including CRLF; sha256_utf8_lf hashes the normalized source text.

profile: Intel Family 6 / Model B7; bare metal, MSR support. Explicit CPU, no all-core/package broadcast.

original_experiment.finding: Original ignores read/write wrapper status; failed read with untouched output can overwrite other fields.

exclusions: No adjacent PROCHOT, thermal, C-state, platform override or Ring EE bit changes
No reuse of FLEX_RATIO OC lock or PROCHOT lock for unrelated energy fields
Etvb FSP definition is not a runtime bit definition; enhanced TVB remains pending
Readback does not measure energy savings or frequency; no physical hardware acceptance
